description: This file contains the implementation of the ShoppingCartFacade interface, providing methods to manipulate shopping cart data such as adding, updating, removing items, and retrieving cart information in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: ShoppingCartFacadeImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ShoppingCartFacade interface, providing various methods to manage shopping cart operations in the web shop.

methods.name: deleteShoppingCart
methods.description: Deletes a shopping cart by its ID or code, given the store context.

methods.name: addItemsToShoppingCart
methods.description: Adds a shopping cart item to an existing or new shopping cart, calculating totals and returning updated cart data.

methods.name: createCartModel
methods.description: Creates a new ShoppingCart object with a unique code, store, and optional customer, then persists it.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Retrieves shopping cart data based on customer and optional shopping cart ID, returning detailed cart info.

methods.name: removeCartItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the shopping cart by item ID, updates the cart, and returns the updated cart data.

methods.name: updateCartItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item and returns the updated cart data.

methods.name: updateCartItems
methods.description: Updates multiple cart items' quantities in bulk, recalculates prices, and returns the updated cart data.

methods.name: getCartModel
methods.description: Fetches a cart model by shopping cart code and store.
